title: Synthetic footprint and influence-area screening
source: Author-created OpenGeo documentation geometry; no provider data or field observations.
rightsNote: Null fixture metadata deliberately represents unknown source/distribution and land-access rights. Do not infer permission, tenure or consent from the map or the software license.
question: Which synthetic point receptors intersect each explicitly selected area?
influenceBasis: A larger author-drawn rectangle for this numerical exercise; not a buffer, modeled impact zone or regulatory distance.

methods.studio: Existing Screen footprint and influence area: native PostGIS planar CRS84 clip; scope summaries remain separate. Capture actual runtime method/version and input dataset generations from the export.
methods.localCheck: Existing OpenLayers 10.10.0 Polygon.intersectsCoordinate; all points are strictly away from boundaries. This checks fixture counts only, not API, account persistence or hosted acceptance.

limits: Synthetic training example for a supported pilot workflow; no impact significance, households, biodiversity condition, rights, compensation or complete ESIA conclusions.
